kpis.description_fr: 6 M clients électricité (OH, PA, NJ, MD, VA, WV). 5e plus gros transmission + distribution US. Base stable.
kpis.description_en: 6M electric customers (OH, PA, NJ, MD, VA, WV). 5th-largest US T&D. Stable base.

kpis.description_fr: Distribution = service final clients résidentiels + commerciaux. Plus gros segment FE. Cycle régulation Ohio/PA en révision.
kpis.description_en: Distribution = final service to residential + commercial customers. FE's largest segment. Ohio/PA regulation cycle under review.

kpis.description_fr: Transmission = grid haute tension multi-état. FERC-regulated, ROE supérieur. Plan Investissement Energy Future $26B (2024-2028).
kpis.description_en: Transmission = high-voltage multi-state grid. FERC-regulated, higher ROE. Energy Future investment plan $26B (2024-2028).

kpis.description_fr: Plan Capex Energy Future $26B 2024-2028 = grid + EV charging + renewable interconnection. Croissance rate base double-digit.
kpis.description_en: Energy Future Capex plan $26B 2024-2028 = grid + EV charging + renewable interconnection. Double-digit rate base growth.

kpis.description_fr: Réduction CO2 atteinte ~30 % vs 2005 baseline. Cible carbon-neutral d'ici 2050. Levier shift gas + renouvelables.
kpis.description_en: CO2 reduction reached ~30% vs 2005 baseline. Carbon-neutral goal by 2050. Lever: gas + renewables shift.
